name: hangboard one arm hang
description: A hang from a hangboard edge with one hand, training finger strength one side at a time. It is an advanced option, best kept for climbers who can already hold a one-arm lock-off on a big hold for the full length of the hang.
instructions: Grip the edge with one hand in the grip you want to train.
Take weight off with your other hand on a sling or with a pulley if you need to.
Lift your feet and hang with the elbow slightly bent and the shoulder pulled down and engaged.
Keep your hips still and stop your body from twisting.
Hold for 5-10 seconds, then step down under control.
Switch hands and rest longer than you would after a two-arm hang.
